# FIXTURE: bad-04 — bare speech verb at line end without לֵאמֹר
# Pattern: וַיֹּאמֶר at line end with content following on next line
# Rule: H5/speech-framing, REVIEW-REQUIRED (secondary check)
# Expected: ≥1 finding with severity REVIEW-REQUIRED

1:1
וַיִּקְרַב אֵלָיו רַב הַחֹבֵל וַיֹּאמֶר
מַה לְּךָ נִרְדָּם׃
